name: Scope Blueprint
concept: One gridded studio drawing makes a defined scope a central boundary, with the five other reasons typeset as marginal notes.
silhouette: narrow editorial headline column beside an architectural plan with an inset dark scope boundary
interaction: The scope outline draws once in view; all notes, claim qualifications, and the boundary are readable without motion or JavaScript.
safety: The grid and boundary are design metaphors, not a contract, recorded scope, or payment document. Both claims have adjacent qualifications.
